description: This file defines React components for rendering and interacting with a data table, including row rendering, keyboard navigation, selection handling, and pagination based on scroll position.

methods.name: TableRow
methods.description: Component that renders a single row of the table with cells, handling hover, focus, click, double click, context menu, and cell rendering.

methods.name: Table
methods.description: Main component that renders the entire table, manages pagination, keyboard navigation, row selection, and headers.
